keywords: ERC-8324 优先级更新注册表
summary: 周六较安静。Flashbots 的 quintus 提交 ERC-8324 优先级更新注册表（PUR），为以太坊上的 PropAMM 提供共享合约，该合约自 2026 年 5 月已在主网运行并承载了几乎全部 PropAMM 交易量。EIP-7928（BAL）关于 SSTORE stipend 与冷状态跟踪的澄清合并。

items.title: Magicians：ERC-8324 优先级更新注册表（PUR）
items.note: 03:14（quintus），对应 ERC PR 提交。PUR 是单一共享合约，面向 EVM 上的 PropAMM 等场景；一个实例自 5 月起在以太坊上运行，承载多个 builder 中几乎全部 PropAMM 交易量，作者希望在各 EVM 链上标准化。
items.note_en: 03:14 (quintus), with the ERC PR submitted. PUR is a single shared contract for PropAMMs on the EVM and similar uses; an instance has been live on Ethereum since May, handling almost all PropAMM volume across multiple builders, and the author hopes to standardize it across EVM chains.

summary_en: A quiet Saturday. Flashbots' quintus submitted ERC-8324, the Priority Update Registry (PUR), a shared contract for PropAMMs on Ethereum; an instance has run on mainnet since May 2026 and handles almost all PropAMM volume. An EIP-7928 (BAL) clarification of SSTORE stipend and cold state tracking was merged.
